note: exact Fraction decode/add/encode, round-ties-even. DIVERGES FROM specs/numeric/gf16.t27 IN TWO WAYS, and the difference is in the expected values here: (1) the spec declares GF16_NAN = 0xFE01, with the sign bit set, while this oracle builds a quiet NaN family-generically as (exp_max << mant_bits) | 1 = 0x7E01; (2) the spec flushes subnormals to zero, this oracle uses gradual underflow. A spec-conformant design therefore disagrees with these vectors on those inputs and is not thereby wrong. Measured 2026-08-11: three independently stored copies of gf16_mul.v each produced exactly 110 mismatches out of 994 against this pack -- 55 NaN sign, 13 flushed subnormals, 4 one-LSB, 38 other.
